The duration of epileptiform activity following an electric head stun in sheep is dependent upon excitant amino acid receptors.

the effects of an electric stun and the administration of drugs that modify amino acid transmitter systems on the induction of epileptiform activity, and the suppression of reflexes in the stunned animal.
the effects of an electric stun applied at the head on the central nervous system of sheep.
the development of a non-lethal, non-injurious method of stunning sheep and cattle.
